cases.statement: Losing a workplace mentor in year two causes apprentices to disengage.
alternatives: Wage stagnation in year two causes disengagement.

passages.text: In the 2021 cohort, sites that removed mentoring in year two saw retention rise by 6%, and engagement surveys did not decline.

cases.statement: Daily reading practice improves vocabulary in all primary pupils.

passages.text: For pupils with diagnosed dyslexia, daily reading practice showed no vocabulary gain over twelve months without additional phonics support.

cases.statement: Remote work reduces productivity in software teams.
